_doc: Sites, zones and commissioned devices. GW-01 is the real SiWx917 board (source device): its data only ever comes
from twin/gateway/*. Every other device is simulated by tools/site_sim.py (source sim) on twin/<site>/<device>/<channel>.
Positions are metres in the layout.json grid (origin = warehouse NW corner, x east, z south).

devices.label: Phone as badge TD-BADGE-01 (seen by GW-01)
Fire pump house panel bridge (read only)

production._doc: Production analytics (backend/twindock/production.py). Vibration is flagged 'abnormal compared with baseline' when the rolling mean's z-score against the learned baseline exceeds z_threshold. It is never a failure prediction.

raw_material._doc: Raw blanks for the presses: one raw pallet holds blanks_per_pallet; line_side_kit_blanks were already at the presses when the twin started. Blanks used = parts the presses made.

vibration_zones_mm_s._doc: ISO 10816-1 class I (machines up to 15 kW): upper limits of zones A, B and C in mm/s RMS; above C is zone D.

safety._doc: Proximity rule (backend/twindock/safety.py): a badge near a MOVING forklift. Warning below warn_m, critical below crit_m; cleared above warn_m + clear_margin_m. K3 (backend/twindock/safety.py): direction factors, fall/man-down, heat index, adjacency for gas evacuation, lone-worker check-ins, shift and break settings.
safety._doc_r4: Heat stress: a worker's effective heat index is the zone's heat index plus their work's metabolic adjustment (heavier work feels hotter, like the lower WBGT limits for heavy work in ACGIH/ISO 7243); rest reminders come more often for heavier work. evac_walk_mps is the evacuation planning speed used to predict how long a muster takes.

privacy._doc: K3 privacy by design: worker positions only on screens during an active safety condition or an evacuation (location 'alerts_only'); incident history kept retention_days; no tracking off site or off shift.

utilities._doc: Campus wiring for the simulator (backend/sim/models/utilities.py) and the energy summary: which meter is the incomer, the generator and each feeder, and which zones are critical (generator-backed). Every physical number is in backend/sim/params/utilities.yaml.

tariff._doc: Example time-of-day tariff for the demo (peak +20 %, night −15 %, a common Indian commercial structure); a real site uses its utility's schedule.

quality_bands._note: Example discharge limits for the demo; a real plant uses the values in its permit.

cmms._doc: Maintenance and automatic actions (backend/twindock/control.py): who is sent, standard job times, limits. A plant's CMMS and BMS settings, not simulation physics.
